presets.label: Calm climb
presets.description: A steady, relaxed signal for a full minute: alpha stays up and 13-30 Hz power stays low.

presets.label: Rising tension
presets.description: Starts relaxed, then muscle tension builds in longer bursts until it holds. Muscle activity is part of this signal.

presets.label: Jaw clench bursts
presets.description: A relaxed signal broken by four-second jaw clenches with rests between. Muscle activity is a large part of this signal.

presets.label: Mixed climb
presets.description: Calm, then a tense stretch, then recovery: the whole range in one run.

presets.label: Noisy pin
presets.description: A relaxed signal while one pin picks up interference for a stretch, then the pin is reseated.
